title: Moderation Policies
intro: Set the limits and options for future moderation decisions.
notifyStaffGuidance: Show optional guidance reminders to moderation staff
protectedRules: Founder-only actions, protected accounts, independent appeals, and mandatory notices keep their existing rules. Existing sanctions keep their end dates.
dependencies: Keep at least one reason category, enter a suggested duration within both limits, and provide guidance before enabling reminders.
confirm: I confirm this change to future moderation decisions.
